title: Discrete-event simulation of hospital flow
primary_chapter_title: Human–AI Decision Systems and Managerial Action
purpose: Simulates arrivals, queues, service times, capacity, prioritization, and delays to assess how AI-enabled triage or scheduling affects operations.
input: `Scenarios` sheet with scenario, arrival rate, service rate, number of servers, priority accuracy, and operating hours; `Parameters` sheet with replications and warm-up hours.
outputs: Replication-level wait, queue, utilization, throughput, delay-cost results; scn summary; uncertainty intervals; waiting-time chart.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
